title: Joint normalized comparison restricted to K-flat representatives
statement: Let f:Z→Y be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Use the derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], derived pullback F [def-pc-derived-pullback], termwise tensor pullback H [def-pc-module-pullback], the recorded derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and the canonical shifted-unit comparison c [def-sc-scheme-canonical-shift-unit-iso] built from [def-sc-scheme-canonical-tensor-shift]. Assume F has a supplied strong monoidal structure and tensorPullback f is additive. Let q be the homotopy quotient, Q the derived localization, G=H⋙Q_Z, and let C consist of the homotopy objects literally equal to q(P) or q(P)[1] for a K-flat complex P [def-pc-kflat-complex]. There exist jointly e:F(O_Y[1])≅O_Z[1] and isomorphisms α_X:F(Q(X))≅G(X) for X∈C. For every homotopy map s:X→X' with both ends in C, F(Q(s))≫α_X'=α_X≫G(s). For every K-flat P with X=q(P), α_(X[1])≫commShift_G(X)=F(commShift_Q(X))≫b(Q(X))≫α_X[1], where b(K)=F(c_Y(K)⁻¹) followed by the supplied inverse tensorator at (O_Y[1],K), then e tensor identity, then c_Z(F(K)). No natural transformation or component at an object outside C is part of this assertion.

source.place: K-flat representative construction and its supplied-tensorator shift coherence, restricted before homotopy-category descent (agent expansion, not a literal assertion of 06YJ).

proof.text: For any complex P, obtain compatible bounded-above flat replacements E_n of its good truncations. Set B = coproduct E_n and phi = id_B - Sigma.desc(t_n; inclusion_(n+1)). The sum of the augmentations annihilates phi, so mappingCone.desc with zero shifted component gives a map s:Cone(phi)->P. The telescope comparison makes s a quasi-isomorphism. Bounded-above flatness and K-flat closure make Cone(phi) K-flat. Retain the literal telescope shape in isFlatTelescope. This is the proved private exists_flat_telescope_resolution helper; no arbitrary resolution data is defined.

Use the normalized comparison only on the concrete telescope resolving class and its one-fold translates. Apply exists_natTrans_from_resolvingClass to Qh followed by derivedPullback and the termwise pullback followed by Qh. The source inverts quasi-isomorphisms. This constructs epsilon on the homotopy category whose components agree with the telescope comparisons.

Prove naturality of the explicit shifted-unit tensor composite from canonical tensor-shift naturality, left-unitor naturality, and tensorator naturality. Package it as a natural isomorphism b without choosing a shift structure on derivedPullback. The two sides of the required epsilon shift square are natural transformations. They agree at every telescope by the residual theorem. For any homotopy object resolve it by a telescope, precompose the two naturality squares by its shifted quasi-isomorphism, and cancel its invertible source image. Thus the square holds on every homotopy object.

If P is K-flat, resolve it by a telescope s:R->P. Tensor pullback sends this quasi-isomorphism between K-flat complexes to a quasi-isomorphism. In the epsilon naturality square, the source image, target image, and epsilon_R are invertible, hence epsilon_P is invertible. The global shift square then implies invertibility at q(P)[1] by cancellation of the target shift comparison. Define alpha_X as asIso(epsilon_X) for the original resolving class. Naturality is epsilon.naturality, and the square is the previously proved equality at q(P). The original statement and predicate are unchanged.
